name: Satiety
kind: A resource that turns bad the more of it has recently been taken, and recovers on a hidden time scale.
source: Negative frequency dependence, patch depletion and marginal value (foraging ecology); satiation and habituation/recovery in animal learning; leaky-integrator non-stationarity in bandits.

rungs.text: (world (meta (link L7) (q S) (cap Ladder) (group satiety)) (let b 0) (let tau (exp (uniform (log 3.60) (log 9.60)))) (on tick (set b (* b (exp (/ (- TICK) tau)))) (set poison (if (>= b 1) F P))) (on score (if (= colour F) (set b (+ b 1)))) (told (if (>= b 1) F P)))
rungs.desc: Hidden leaky tally of recent good meals with threshold 1; past it the good colour turns poison until the tally decays (time scale drawn per life). Learn: which colour is food (1 bit), the threshold (~1.0 bits plus its count tracking), the recovery time scale (~3 bits), and that eating itself causes the flip, so switch after ~1 meals and return after the wait.
